'''Oasis Northeast''' was a small body of [[Water/Legends|water]] located near the [[Krayt Graveyard]] on the desert world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oasis Northeast was one of four bodies of water on the [[:w:c:swg:Planet|planet]] [[:w:c:swg:Tatooine|Tatooine]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The other three were the [[Imperial Oasis]], the [[Oasis South|South Oasis]], and the [[Oasis East]].<ref name="SWG" />

Unlike the other oases in the game, the name of Oasis Northeast could not be identified using the in-game search feature.<ref name="SWG" /> However, the ''Star Wars Galaxies'' TRE files listed the oasis as Oasis Northeast.
